title: Night Web's Hollow
wikitext:
[[image:Night Web's Hollow.jpg|thumb|Night Web's Hollow]]
'''Night Web's Hollow''' is a small valley and mine just northwest of [[Deathknell]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. Both the outdoors vale and the indoors mine is infested with [[spider]]s, which skitter among the shadows and lurk from their webbed corners. Young [[Forsaken]] usually test their mettle against the numerous spiders and sometimes venture deep into the mine to uncover its dusty secrets.

Outside the mine, [[Young Night Web Spider]]s wander about. The mine itself houses many adult [[Night Web Spider]]s. In the deepest recesses of the mine, the [[Night Web Matriarch]] sits.
